name: ritsu
description: The Agent Skills of ritsu, one plugin with a skill for ritsu and one for each of its seven languages.

plugins.name: ritsu
plugins.description: Agent Skills for ritsu and its seven small languages: business rules (rulec), workflows (dandori), dates (koyomi), ledgers (chobo), claims about code (geas), where requirements come from (yuen) and maps of bounded contexts (sakai). The skills run the ritsu binary, which has to be on PATH.
